reason: narrow_scopes returns sorted(set(requested) | set(granted)), which is the union, but Req 1 requires the intersection. For narrow_scopes(['b','c'], ['a','b']) it returns ['a','b','c'] instead of ['b'], so the contributor's own test_narrow_scopes fails despite the report claiming exit 0. has_all_required_scopes returns bool(set(token_scopes) & set(required)), which is True when any scope overlaps; Req 2 requires True only when every required scope is in token_scopes, so it should be set(required) <= set(token_scopes). The commit signature only verifies authorship, not correctness.
